mission: Leap 9: Complete Test Suite Recovery to 100%
strategic_goal: Achieve constitutional Article II compliance (100% test pass rate)

context.remaining_work: Phases 2-3 from Leap 8 (timeout resolution, assertion fixes)

tasks.title: Increase test suite timeout to 5 minutes
tasks.description: Update run_tests.py to support dynamic timeout calculation based on test count. Constitutional Article I requires complete context - 2min timeout prevents full test suite visibility. Formula: timeout = test_count * 150ms + 60s safety margin. Implement timeout multiplier support for retries (2x, 3x, 10x).
acceptance_criteria: run_tests.py timeout increased from 120s to 300s default
Full test suite completes without timeout (1,762 tests)
Execution time baseline documented (<10 min target)

tasks.title: Catalog all remaining test failures
tasks.description: Run full test suite with --tb=short to catalog all failures. Parse output to identify: (1) Remaining assertion failures (~20 expected), (2) Any uncovered blockers (segfaults/hangs), (3) Import errors or environment issues. Create TestFailureCatalog with failure types, root causes, priority ranking, and effort estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Complete failure catalog with no timeouts
Root cause identified for each failure type
Priority ranking: critical path tests first

tasks.title: Classify failures by auto-fixability
tasks.description: Implement TestFailureClassifier to categorize failures by fixability: (1) Trivial (pure deletions, <5 lines, auto-fixable), (2) Simple (single function edits, unit test validation, auto-fixable), (3) Moderate (multi-function changes, integration tests), (4) Complex (architectural changes, manual fix required). Use LLM analysis (qwen2.5-coder:32b) for assertion failure root cause analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Risk scores assessed for each fix
Classification report generated with fix strategies

tasks.title: Fix any remaining blocker failures
tasks.description: Fix any critical blockers discovered in Phase 1 cataloging: (1) Segfaults (if any), (2) Hangs (if any), (3) Import errors blocking other tests. Use constitutional timeout policy (2x, 3x, 10x retries) if fixes require iteration. Quarantine truly unfixable tests with clear documentation and skip markers.
acceptance_criteria: Import errors fixed or dependencies documented

tasks.title: Fix first 10 assertion failures
tasks.description: Fix top 10 assertion failures by priority ranking from Phase 1 classification. Focus on: (1) Schema mismatches (Pydantic model updates), (2) Environment variable issues (fixture cleanup), (3) Test expectation updates (behavior changes). Apply fixes from VectorStore patterns (confidence >=0.80). Verify each fix with test pass before proceeding to next.
acceptance_criteria: All fixes verified with test execution

tasks.title: Fix remaining assertion failures
tasks.description: Fix remaining assertion failures (~10-20 expected). Continue methodology from batch_1. If any tests represent truly broken features (not test bugs), document as known issues with clear repro steps and mark with @pytest.mark.skip(reason='Known issue: <description>'). Ensure all skipped tests have JIRA tickets or GitHub issues for tracking.
acceptance_criteria: All assertion failures fixed or documented
Known issues tracked with skip markers and tickets
Test suite shows only PASSED/SKIPPED (no FAILED)
All skipped tests have tracking issues

tasks.title: Run test suite 3 times for stability
tasks.description: Execute full test suite 3 times consecutively to verify stability (no flakiness). Run with 'python run_tests.py --run-all' and capture: (1) Pass/fail counts, (2) Execution time per run, (3) Any flaky tests (different results across runs), (4) Memory usage during execution. Document baseline metrics for future performance monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: 3 consecutive runs with 100% pass rate (excluding documented skips)
Consistent results across all 3 runs (no flakiness)
Baseline metrics documented for future comparison

tasks.title: Complete ADR-031 documentation
tasks.description: Update ADR-031-test-suite-recovery.md with Leap 9 completion details: (1) Final test count (1,762/1,762 or X skipped), (2) Execution time baseline, (3) List of quarantined tests with reasons, (4) Patterns applied from VectorStore, (5) Lessons learned from Leap 8 + Leap 9. Mark ADR status as 'Complete' with completion date.
acceptance_criteria: Final test metrics documented (count, pass rate, execution time)
Quarantined tests listed with skip reasons and tracking issues

tasks.title: Extract and store test fixing patterns
tasks.description: Extract patterns from Leap 9 execution and store to VectorStore: (1) Test fixing strategies (schema updates, fixture cleanup, isolation), (2) Classification patterns (auto-fixability scoring), (3) Timeout handling (dynamic calculation), (4) Stability validation (3-run methodology). Minimum confidence 0.6 per Article IV. Store 5+ patterns with evidence and confidence scores.
acceptance_criteria: All patterns stored to VectorStore with tags
Evidence counts documented for each pattern

checkpoints.prompt: Verify complete failure catalog and classification before starting fixes
Verify 100% pass rate achieved before stability validation

constitutional_alignment.article_i: Complete context (full failure catalog, no timeouts)
